name: Ai-Da
summary: Billed as the first ultra-realistic humanoid robot artist, Ai-Da was conceived by gallerist Aidan Meller and built on an Engineered Arts body, with camera eyes and a robotic drawing arm driven by generative algorithms from Oxford researchers. It produces drawings, paintings and — with human assistance — sculpture, and is used as a prompt for debate about AI and creativity.
notable: First humanoid robot presented as a working artist
A 2024 Ai-Da painting of Alan Turing sold at auction for over US$1 million
